name: Dr. Siddharth Malhotra, BDS, MDS
title: Lead Cosmetic & Implant Specialist
bio: Dr. Siddharth Malhotra believes dentistry should feel soothing, empowering, and completely transparent. Trained at AIIMS New Delhi with advanced clinical fellowships in micro-invasive cosmetic restoration and dental implantology, he has transformed over 4,500 smiles with a gentle, patient-first philosophy. He is passionate about making modern dental care accessible, anxiety-free, and pain-free for every patient.
